finalText:
**Big but mechanical.** 1082 hits in 94 files.

| Area | Rename? | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `services/*` JS names | yes | 75 files, internal only |
| SQL strings in `repo/` | no | 125 lines name the DB column |
| `migrations/*.sql` | no | applied history, breaks the down step |
| [`docs/openapi.yaml`](docs/openapi.yaml:16) | no | public contract, frozen |
| [`lib/serialize.js`](lib/serialize.js:8) `WIRE` values | no | wire name clients read |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | no | regenerated by `vendor:refresh` |

Next: sign off only on the internal rename. The wire name stays `account_id` without a new API version and a column migration.
